title: Move Zeroes
description: Move all zeros to the end while maintaining the relative order of non-zero elements.

data.text: Given an array `nums`, move all `0`s to the end while preserving the order of non-zero elements. Do it in-place without copying the array.
Collect non-zeros, then pad zeros at the end. O(n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: Extra Array O(n)

data.text: Keep a pointer for the next non-zero position. Swap each non-zero into place. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Two Pointers O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n) both ways. **Space:** O(n) → O(1). The two-pointer swap does the work in-place with a single pass.
